name: IPhone 4

Launch.Announced / released: GSM model (black): 2010-06-24 , CDMA model (black): 2011-02-10 , GSM and CDMA models (white): 2011-04-28 , 8 GB models: 2011-10-04

Platform.Operating system: Original: iOS 4.0 (GSM model), iOS 5.0 (8 GB model), iOS 4.2.10 (CDMA model), Last: iOS 7.1.2, released 2014-06-30
Platform.CPU: 1 GHz (Underclocked to 800 MHz) single core 32-bit ARM Cortex-A8

Display.Display: 3.5 in diagonal 3:2 aspect ratio widescreen , LED backlit IPS TFT LCD, 960×640 resolution at 326 ppi (0.61 megapixels), 800:1 contrast ratio (typical) , 500 cd/m2 max brightness (typical) , Fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating on front and back glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MP back-side illuminated sensor , HD video (720p) at 30 frame/s , 1.75 μm size pixels , 5× digital zoom , 4 element lens , LED flash , Photo and video geotagging
Cameras.Front camera: 0.3 MP VGA (480p) at 30 fps, Tap to focus video or still images , Photo and video geotagging

Sound.Sound: Single loudspeaker , 3.5 mm TRRS, frequency response: 20 Hz to 20 kHz

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n) (2.4 Bluetooth 2.1 + EDR, GSM model: quad-band GSM/GPRS/EDGE , (800, 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz), Quad-band UMTS/HSDPA/HSUPA , (800, 850, 900, 1900, 2100 MHz) (800 MHz is not yet officially supported by Apple), CDMA model: dual-band CDMA/EV-DO Rev. A (800, 1900 MHz)
